title: Binomial Theorem
subtitle: Algebra · Combinatorics
summary: Expands (x+y)ⁿ as a sum weighted by binomial coefficients.
detail:
\[ (x+y)^n = \sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}x^{n-k}y^k \]

The binomial coefficients \(\binom{n}{k}=\frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}\) form Pascal's triangle and satisfy \(\binom{n}{k}=\binom{n-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-1}{k}\). Extends to non-integer \(n\) via the generalised binomial series.
